scope: One scoped CPU-only worker runs the four original full serial scale-first/q predicates while the original caller performs NVRTC/module, pinned staging allocation and ArenaLayout construction. All CUDA/context/stream/budget/plan remain on the original caller. The fixed >=64 MiB quantized-byte eligibility matches admitted D131; smaller/F32 paths retain original in-upload serial checks. Borrowed tokens accept only identical Store and cannot escape initialization; original snapshot guards execute at consumption. No skipped checks, persistent cache, changed integer grouping, kernel/math/quality/upload/state/layout/save changes.
serial_fallback: No tokens computed for ineligible fixtures; original per-upload scans remain. F32 contributes zero eligibility bytes. OS spawn failure computes original checks serially after setup.
safety: Only immutable Store borrows reach worker. Setup reads Spot/tree/plan and owns its allocations; no concurrent traversal, Store write or GPU API on worker. Tokens remain borrowed until final upload and cannot be stored in GpuSolver. Wrong-store token conservatively declines zero path. Setup error priority and joined panic/drop semantics match the 12 tested D131 cases.
risks: Speculative scans on setup failure, CPU/cache contention, pinned memory allocation, warm/F32/snapshot and process shape differences require integrated/broad/material checks. No component timing is a complete-solve claim.
